test_title: PYST 12: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The __**deteriorated**__ building was declared unsafe for the inmates.
solution: The correct answer is **"dilapidated."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Deteriorated"** means to become worse. ((स्थिति का) बिगड़ना, बदतर होना) • **Example**: *She was taken into hospital last week when her condition suddenly **deteriorated**__.* • Synonym of **"deteriorated"** is **"dilapidated."** • **"Dilapidated"** means (used about buildings, furniture, etc.) old and broken. ((भवन, फ़र्नीचर आदि) जीर्ण-शीर्ण, टूटा-फूटा) __ • **Example**: *The old house was so **dilapidated**__ that it was deemed unsafe to live in.* • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2 (dissipated) **means to scatter or disappear. (धीरे-धीरे कम होते-होते ग़ायब हो जाना, समाप्त हो जाना; धारे-धीरे कमज़ोर हो कर ख़त्म हो जाना) • **Option 3 (meliorated)** means to improve or make better. (सुधारना या बेहतर बनाना) • **Option 4 (reprobated)** means to condemn or disapprove of. (निंदा करना या अस्वीकार करना) 40:Tb3f, The correct answer is **"Was fish out of water."**
